observation.visible_scene: Two cream-colored floor mats printed with 'KITCHEN RULES' and 'COOK WITH LOVE' lie flat on a patch of dark, ashy dirt, with a strip of green grass along the left edge. A gray, curved, partially melted piece (handle-like) rests on the lower mat. Small orange flames burn along the touching edges of the two mats and around the left/top of the gray piece, with blackened, charred mat edges already present.
visible_changes: The flames flicker continuously frame-to-frame: the fire at the seam between the two mats swells and shrinks, and the fire around the gray piece changes shape, at times throwing a horizontal tongue of flame to the left (e.g. around the 5th sample) and at other times burning more compactly.
Faint wisps of gray smoke rise intermittently over the upper mat near the burning seam.
The two mats, the gray piece, the charred edges, and the surrounding ground/ash remain in fixed positions with no translation, rotation, or deformation during the clip.
The camera framing stays essentially static; background elements (grass, ash scatter, mat positions) hold the same screen location throughout, apart from negligible handheld jitter.
outside_clip_unknowns: What ignited the mats and the gray piece, and any earlier state before this segment.
The material identity of the gray curved object and whether it was already melted before the clip.
Any later outcome (full consumption of the mats, extinguishing, or spread of the fire) beyond the final sample.
uncertain_details: Whether the very small frame-to-frame shifts in framing are handheld jitter or none; no deliberate pan/zoom is evident.
The exact shape changes of the flame are flicker, not directional movement of the fire source; the gray piece shows no visible melting progression within this short segment.
